tools.name: query_curriculum
tools.description: Search and inspect any of the 131 runnable Hedera by Example labs. Returns full runnable code, concept, learnable moments, and SDK references.

query.description: Search term, concept, or SDK class (e.g., 'x402', 'TransferTransaction', 'Merkle', 'EVM', 'TokenCreate')

lang.description: Language of explanation and code comments (default: 'en')

tools.name: query_knowledge
tools.description: Query the Hedera Master Knowledge Graph across AI agents, RWA, DePIN, Passkeys, zk-TLS, and L1 consensus services.

category.description: Filter category (e.g., 'AI & Autonomous Agents', 'DePIN & Hardware IoT', 'Asset Tokenization & RWA')

tools.name: anti_hallucination_rules
tools.description: Retrieve strict anti-hallucination rules and technical guardrails for building on Hedera with @hiero-ledger/sdk.

tools.name: architecture_decision_tree
tools.description: Retrieve the architectural decision matrix guiding when to use Hedera Consensus Service (HCS), Token Service (HTS), or Smart Contracts (HSCS).

tools.name: mirror_node_query
tools.description: Interrogate the public Hedera Mirror Node REST API in real-time. Free read-only state lookup for accounts, tokens, and topics.

id.description: Hedera entity ID (e.g. '0.0.12345' or EVM address '0x...')

tools.name: official_resources
tools.description: Search official Hedera documentation, repositories, and specifications with verified update timestamps.

query.description: Search term for official URLs and documentation
